text:
Anya Patel: Quick ask — our SRE final has a tight candidate window tomorrow 16:00–16:30 PT. Can the panel debrief happen immediately after at 16:35? We'll need a scribe and someone to submit scores. Also need a small rubric tweak due to an env hiccup. @Lindsey Cho @Ben O'Neill
Lindsey Cho: I can scribe if that helps. 30-min debrief is fine as a condensed format — 10m notes, 15m scoring, 5m finalize. :+1:
Ben O'Neill: I can submit scores. One Q: do we treat takehome vs live infra tasks differently in weighting? The rubric's tech % is a bit ambiguous for this scenario.
Maria Gomez: Related — candidate hit an env setup flake during the live task. I'd favor shifting emphasis to system design. Proposal: Tech 55 / Behavior 45 with breakdown: design 30, debugging 25, comms 20, culture 25.
Anya Patel: Thanks. Here's the canonical snippet from the rubric doc: https://redwood/docs/hiring/rubrics — current is "Tech: 60% (design 30, coding 30); Behavior: 40% (collab 20, growth 20)". Do we want to override for this role/candidate?
Ben O'Neill: I'd rather not flip too far. Suggest keep Tech 60 but move 5% from coding->design because of the hiccup. So: Tech 60 (design 35, coding 25), Behavior 40 (collab 20, growth 20). I'm okay with that and will follow it for scoring.
Lindsey Cho: Works for me. I'll scribe and use the compact template: bullets + per-category scores + 1-line recommendation. I'll post the doc after the interview and tag everyone.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Please submit final scores within 24 hours to /hiring/scores. Automated calendar invite will be sent to the panel.
Calendar Bot: Meeting created — "SRE final — debrief (compact)" 2024-05-14 16:35 PT (30m). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/meet/xyz
Anya Patel: Perfect. If someone can't make 16:35 in real time, async notes are fine. @Ben O'Neill can you still submit if you're delayed? Also quick CR ping — infra test PR needs a review by 11am so we can attach logs to the debrief.
Ben O'Neill: Yep I'll submit asynchronously by EOD if needed. I'll also try to review the PR, but if I miss it I'll add comments in the debrief doc.
Maria Gomez: I'll take the PR review in repo `infra-tests` now, pinged you in the repo. Thanks!
